notes: Fresh session per run, in the OIA project's cloud environment, push notification to the sponsor on finish. Days and times never overlap; every run also takes the OIA lock. Runs read evidence and write only to /mnt/project-files/oia/.

tasks.name: OIA weekly assurance review
tasks.guard: No baseline report yet: run health only and stop.
tasks.budget: One session; at most 15 sampled items per area.

tasks.name: OIA monthly maturity assessment
tasks.guard: No baseline yet: stop. Weekly lock held: stop and report the clash.

tasks.name: OIA corrective action verification
tasks.guard: Nothing due: ledger entry only, no report.
tasks.budget: One session; only findings whose due or sustainment date has passed.

tasks.name: OIA behavioural challenge (design only)
tasks.guard: Design and seal only. Launch needs the sponsor's approval of that specific challenge.
tasks.budget: One session; one challenge a month.
tasks.activation: Sponsor enables after the baseline report.
